title: Raw Silk Wrap Top
description: Hand-cut wrap top in raw silk, finished with a single exposed seam along the spine. Falls loose through the body, cinches at the waist.

title: Bone Linen Trousers
description: Wide-leg trousers in heavyweight linen, dyed to a warm bone tone. High waist, deep pockets, no lining.

title: Sinew Slip Dress
description: Bias-cut slip dress with hand-stitched straps. Sits close through the hip, moves with the body.

title: Plum Wool Coat
description: Structured mid-length coat in plum wool, single button closure, dropped shoulder. Originally made and sold — can be recreated to your own measurements.

title: Marrow Silk Blouse
description: Loose blouse in bone-toned silk with a single hand-rolled hem. Originally made and sold — can be recreated to your own measurements.
